projects.subtitle: Cross-team work.

tasks.scoreHidden: Your own scores are never shown to you.

requests.anyReceiver: You choose who it goes to

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Club events and meetings.

calendar.visibilityHint: Choose freely — widening visibility never needs anyone's approval.

calendar.noEntries: Nothing on the calendar this month.

assets.subtitle: Club equipment and who has it.

attendance.subtitle: One record per person per activity.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Configuration that takes effect without a deploy.
admin.permissionsHint: Every access check in the system reads this table. Changing a scope here changes what a role can do immediately — no code change, no redeploy.
admin.overridesHint: A team-specific exception to the baseline. This is how member management belongs to HR's Directors and nobody else's.
admin.requestTypesHint: Each type is configuration: a form definition, a set of statuses, and the transitions allowed between them.
admin.importHint: CSV only — there is no public registration. Every row is checked before anything is written; if one row fails, nothing is imported.
admin.importColumns: Expected columns: email, name_en, name_ar, student_id, national_id, team, role, and optionally phone, college, academic_level, graduation_term, projects.
admin.importFailed: Nothing was imported. Fix these problems and try again:
admin.roomsHint: Add rooms, set the booking window, and block time off.
admin.googleHint: Connect the club's Google account for Meet links and invitations.

kpi.title: KPI
kpi.subtitle: Club performance, computed live from tasks and projects.
kpi.noAccess: You do not have permission to view KPI.
kpi.ownHidden: Your own figures are never included — §8 applies to everyone.
kpi.chartHint: Hover a bar for the exact figure.
kpi.fallingBehindHint: Members and splits whose own figures are Needs Attention or At Risk.
kpi.nobodyBehind: Nobody is flagged as falling behind.
kpi.empty: No KPI data yet. Figures appear once tasks are confirmed or marked Not Done.
kpi.chartRiskHint: Open tasks by §4 risk tier, recomputed from today’s date.

rooms.adminSubtitle: Set up the club's bookable rooms and when they can be booked.
rooms.noRooms: No rooms yet. Add one to start taking bookings.
rooms.settingsHint: One setting for every room. Times use the 24-hour clock; midnight is 24:00.
rooms.blockTimeHint: Takes a room out of service. It behaves exactly like a booking — nobody can book over it — and shows your reason instead of a group name.
rooms.deleteBookingBody: The slot becomes free again straight away. Whoever booked it is not told.
rooms.title: Room schedule
rooms.subtitle: Check what is free and book a room. Click any free block to take it.
rooms.hourUnavailable: An hour would run into the next booking or past closing time.
rooms.notForMembers: The room schedule is for Team Directors, Project Managers, and the Presidency. To use a room, ask your Director to book it.
rooms.noRoomsYet: No rooms have been added yet. IT sets them up under Admin → Rooms.
rooms.noIdentity: You have no team or project to book for yet, so you can see the schedule but not take a slot.

google.title: Google connection
google.subtitle: One shared account creates every Meet link, sends every invitation, and keeps the Mock Interviews floor sheet in sync.
google.notLinked: No Google account is connected yet, so confirmed online meetings will not get a Meet link.
google.connectHint: You will be sent to Google to approve access. Sign in as the club's shared account, not your own.
google.connected: Connected. Confirmed online meetings will now get a Meet link automatically.
google.failed: That did not work ({code}). Check the server log and try again.
google.calendarOnFirstUse: Will be created with the first meeting
google.calendarNote: Meetings go on a separate calendar called “KSU Vision 2030 Club — Meetings”, so the account's own calendar stays clean. You can hide it in Google Calendar without affecting anything here.
google.notConfigured: This server has no Google application set up yet, so the connection cannot be started.
google.setupIntro: A Super Admin does this once:
google.setupStep1: In the Google Cloud console, create a project and enable the Google Calendar API.
google.setupStep2: Create an OAuth client of type “Web application”.
google.setupStep3: Add the redirect URL below to its Authorised redirect URIs.
google.setupStep4: Put the client ID and secret in .env.local as GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI, then restart the server.
google.pendingHint: Confirmed online meetings whose Meet link could not be created yet — usually because Google was unreachable at the time.
google.reconnectNote: Already connected from before this was added? Press Reconnect once so Google grants the extra permission the floor sheet needs.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Get told on your phone when a request needs you, a task is assigned to you, or a meeting is about to start.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
push.installTitle: First, add the app to your Home Screen
push.installSteps: In Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Open Vision 2030 from the new icon and come back to this page.

push.enabledOn: Notifications are on for this device.
push.testSent: Sent to {count, plural, =0 {no devices} =1 {one device} other {# devices}}.
push.nudge: Turn on notifications to hear about requests, tasks and meetings.

overview.setupHint: What the schedule is built from
overview.linksHint: The apply form is public. The TV link is a secret: paste it into the waiting-area screen only.

settings.slugHint: Letters, digits and dashes. Part of the public link.
settings.statusHint: Draft: nothing public. Active: the windows below apply. Archived: read-only forever.
settings.gatesHint: Leave a window blank to keep it closed. Times are on the club’s clock.
settings.ratingLabelsHint: Up to six 1–5 ratings the interviewer gives. The key never changes once used; the labels can.
settings.tvHint: Open this link on the TV. Anyone holding it sees names being called.
settings.rotateTvBody: The old link stops working immediately. Paste the new one into the screen.
settings.feedbackHint: {count} feedback notes are written but not yet sent to students.
settings.releaseFeedbackBody: {count} emails go out now, one per interview. Sent feedback can no longer be edited by the interviewer.
settings.lastExport: Last copy taken {when}. A copy is taken every night.
settings.noExport: No copy taken yet. One is taken every night after 03:00.
settings.notesBody: Applications and booking follow the windows above. A student who applies twice with the same email updates their form until HR decides or they book. Organizers move students through the stages on the Floor tab. Every change is logged with who made it; nothing is ever deleted.
settings.floorSheetHint: A mirror of every booked slot, across every room and day, kept in sync automatically. The Stage column is editable in the Sheet — press “Pull from Sheet” to bring those changes back in. Requires the club's Google account to be connected under Admin → Google.
settings.floorSheetNone: Not created yet — it appears the first time the floor changes, or press Sync now.
settings.floorSheetPulled: Stage changes from the Sheet were applied, and the Sheet was refreshed to match.
settings.floorSheetPullHint: Reads the Stage column of every day tab and applies any changes (Not Arrived / Arrived / In Interview / Finished / No Show) to the matching booking. Nothing happens automatically — only when this is pressed.

companies.rotateBody: The old link stops working immediately. Send the new one to the company.
companies.pinHint: A short code the interviewer types once per day, in case the link is forwarded.
companies.addRoomHint: Creates the room and its own booking link, with that one day’s 2pm–8pm slots in 15-minute steps ready to book.
companies.addPhonesHint: One per line. Anyone who logs in on the room link with one of these numbers sees the available times right away.
companies.deleteBody: Its candidate link stops working and it disappears from this list, but nothing is erased — its bookings and history stay exactly as they are, including on the live Google Sheet. You can restore it any time.

people.organizersHint: Chosen by the project’s managers. They move students through the stages on the day.
people.hrHint: Chosen by HR’s Directors. They review applicants and decide per company.
people.automaticHint: The project’s managers, the Presidency and the Super Admin manage everything here without being listed. HR’s Directors decide without being listed.

applicants.name: Name
